architecture_summary: The fixed local runtime uses startup-triggered two-stage generative formation: recent idle root rollouts are filtered and extracted into a dedicated SQLite candidate/job store, then a sandboxed internal Agent consolidates a global Git-baselined Markdown workspace. Future root threads receive a bounded summary and progressively search/read the file hierarchy lexically; memory citations feed usage/recency selection.

components.name: turn-start Memory dispatcher
components.responsibility: starts background work on qualifying primary root turns and excludes ephemeral/non-root sessions

components.name: Phase 1 extractor
components.responsibility: filters/redacts rollout evidence, calls a low-effort model and persists raw_memory plus rollout_summary

components.name: MemoryStore
components.responsibility: maintains stage1 outputs, usage, selection snapshots, leases, retries and watermarks in memories_1.sqlite

components.name: Phase 2 consolidation Agent
components.responsibility: syncs selected inputs, reads Git diff, rewrites MEMORY.md/summary/skills under a restricted sandbox and commits the baseline

components.name: file artifact workspace
components.responsibility: materializes raw memories and rollout summaries, validates required outputs and rejects symlinks

components.name: Memories extension/read backend
components.responsibility: injects bounded memory_summary context and exposes list/read/search/ad-hoc note tools over the local file root
components.locator: ext/memories extension.rs, backend.rs, local/* and read_path.md

components.name: Memory lifecycle controls
components.responsibility: sets per-thread generation eligibility, marks externally polluted threads, resets generated state and appends explicit user update notes

data_flow.operation: scan recent allowed interactive sources, require enabled memory_mode and idle/age bounds, exclude current thread
filter rollout items, remove developer/AGENTS/skill fragments, redact secrets, truncate to context budget and run extraction model
commit raw_memory, rollout_summary, slug and source watermark under owned job state
select by usage/recency, materialize raw_memories.md and rollout_summaries and compute Git workspace diff
restricted internal consolidation Agent performs incremental synthesis and stale cleanup
inject up to 2500 tokens as a routing index when Memory use is enabled

data_flow.to: selected Memory lines or source rollout
data_flow.operation: model performs bounded substring search/read and progressively opens detail
parse file/line/rollout IDs, hide markup and update Stage 1 usage metadata

dependencies_services.name: StateRuntime SQLite family
dependencies_services.role: state_5.sqlite provides thread metadata while memories_1.sqlite provides candidate/job state; goals and history use separate stores

dependencies_services.name: OpenAI/model-provider inference
dependencies_services.role: Phase 1 extraction and Phase 2 consolidation; default preferred models are Luna and Terra but are configurable/provider-specific

dependencies_services.name: local filesystem plus Git baseline utilities
dependencies_services.role: inspectable final artifacts, input synchronization, incremental diff and stale-input cleanup

dependencies_services.name: Codex core ThreadManager/App Server
dependencies_services.role: starts primary turns, spawns the internal consolidation thread and exposes controls to App/CLI/IDE clients

integration_constraints.constraint: MemoryTool is stable but default-disabled; enabling the feature is separate from generate/use subflags.
Automatic generation requires a primary configured environment, a state DB and a qualifying root interactive session; ephemeral and subagent sessions are skipped.
The local read backend is file/substring based; no embedding or ANN index is present in this path.
The physical store and prompt-resident summary are global per CODEX_HOME; cwd/project/branch boundaries are logical document metadata rather than hard namespaces.
integration_constraints.locator: memory_root, rollout summary metadata and consolidation prompt

integration_constraints.constraint: The consolidation Agent has no network, MCP, Apps, Plugins or recursive collaboration and receives write access only to the Memory root under managed sandboxing.
Custom providers may need explicit extraction/consolidation model overrides; a current issue reports OpenAI model IDs on unsupported providers.

maintenance_evidence.finding: Canonical Apache-2.0 repository is unarchived; current main was pinned at c9b19deb on 2026-08-23 and latest stable release was rust-v0.149.0 on 2026-08-20.
The 90-day fixed-history snapshot contained 2,886 commits by 201 author-email identities; 93 commits touched selected Memory paths. These are activity signals only.
Thirty GitHub workflow files and multiple Memory-specific test files are present; no tests were executed in this report.

issue_pr_findings.finding: Issue #26684 reports OFFSET pagination can skip or duplicate candidates under concurrent inserts; the pinned selection code still uses multiple paginated queries outside one read transaction.
Issue #40110 reports a 0.149.0 background Memory worker repeatedly consuming quota; no independent reproduction or maintainer confirmation was captured.
Issues #18343 and #30299 request project/hybrid scope and structured item management, matching the global file root and note/reset-oriented current surface.
Recent commits hardened symlinks, sandbox roots, artifact validation, shutdown and request/thread-source metadata; post-0.149.0 changes did not replace the core two-stage architecture.
issue_pr_findings.locator: release-to-main path diff and Memory commit history

failure_modes.trigger: important evidence falls outside the truncated head/tail budget or extraction returns no useful output
failure_modes.impact: the source rollout remains, but no Stage 1 candidate reaches global Memory

failure_modes.trigger: cwd/branch qualifiers are omitted or over-compressed during consolidation
failure_modes.impact: project-specific guidance may be surfaced in an unrelated workspace

failure_modes.trigger: Stage 1 inserts change ranked OFFSET pages during multi-query selection
failure_modes.impact: eligible memories may be skipped or revisited before consolidation

failure_modes.trigger: consolidation Agent edits artifacts then fails before validation/baseline reset
failure_modes.impact: a reader may encounter partially updated files until a later repair run

failure_modes.trigger: the model uses Memory but omits or malforms rollout IDs in its citation block
failure_modes.impact: useful Stage 1 outputs do not receive retention reinforcement

failure_modes.trigger: already visible memories receive more citations than relevant but undiscovered memories
failure_modes.impact: usage-ranked consolidation can favor historical exposure rather than true future utility

failure_modes.trigger: generated state is cleared while recent source threads remain enabled and idle
failure_modes.impact: a later startup can extract old rollout evidence again

failure_modes.trigger: malicious content is already present in generated or manually sourced Memory files
failure_modes.impact: future sessions may treat it as useful context despite path-level protections

adoption_boundary: This is the official canonical open-source local Codex runtime and is integrated into documented Codex clients, but this report does not infer independent production adoption, Memory quality, user counts or cloud behavior from stars, repository activity or official ownership.
